## Please open this on GitLab

This GitHub repository is a **read-only mirror** of
<https://gitlab.com/leitwacht/leitwacht-agent>.

Pull requests opened here are not reviewed and will be closed without
merge. Please re-open your change as a merge request on GitLab:

<https://gitlab.com/leitwacht/leitwacht-agent/-/merge_requests/new>

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow.
